I am scrolling through the conversation while the recording continues. The timer shows how long I have been speaking. When I press stop, the phone uploads the audio and waits for the transcript. I can discard the pending recording before any text is sent. If transcription fails, the recording stays available for a retry. Navigation should never change the destination of the message. I can open another conversation, return to the original one, and see the same recording state. The final user bubble contains ordinary text with a microphone symbol and the duration. It should still display those details after the conversation is reopened. We also need to check unrelated words and similar sounding phrases so the vocabulary does not invent names. The final test uses my own voice, compares the same audio against keyboard dictation, and records both accuracy and latency. Thank you Juniper, Atlas, and Rowan.
